documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On November 14, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Onemi Technology reported strong Q2 FY27 results with AUM reaching Rs. 9,317 crore, a 68.4% year-on-year increase. Management highlighted a shift toward higher-quality borrowers and improved asset quality, with credit costs falling to 6.2% of average AUM. The company raised its FY27 AUM growth guidance to over 60% and expects impairment costs to decline by more than 15% year-on-year. Management also confirmed that the LAP business turned profitable in Q2, ahead of previous expectations.

guidance.claim: The company raised its FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus.
guidance.quote: Given the momentum in the first half, we are raising our FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus.

guidance.claim: Management expects impairment costs to reduce by more than 15% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: We are now saying it will be emphatically more than 15% reduction year on year.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its guidance for return on average equity to be above 20% and gross NPA below 2.25%.
guidance.quote: The rest of our guidance stands : return on average equity would be above 20%, and the gross NPA below 2.25%.

guidance.claim: Management firmly holds to its guidance of a 15% reduction in credit cost.
guidance.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

guidance.claim: The company remains firmly on track for the FY27 guidance across parameters including AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability.
guidance.quote: On the guidance for future, we remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance we set out on different parameters, be it AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability including ROE and ROA. I reiterate, we remain firmly on track.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that retail loan sanctions across the industry are up by nearly 20% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Across the industry, retail loan sanctions are up by nearly 20% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed that industry retail credit balances have grown 19%, while the number of borrowers has grown less than 9%.
demand_outlook.quote: Yet, as per Bureau, the industry Retail credit balances have grown 19%, while the number of borrowers has grown less than 9%.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian economy remains steady, providing stability that lenders value.
demand_outlook.quote: On the macro picture, the Indian economy remains steady, and, as you know, this steadiness is what a lender like us values the most.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term credit opportunity in India remains unmistakably large.
demand_outlook.quote: Beyond the ebb and flow of any single quarter, the long-term opportunity in India remains unmistakably gargantuan.

demand_outlook.claim: Bureau data shows a divergence where headline asset quality looks benign, but stress is building in small ticket loans and multiple-lender borrowers.
demand_outlook.quote: The bureau data for the industry now shows a clear divergence beneath a calm surface. Talking about industry, headline asset quality looks benign, yet beneath the surface, stress is building, concentrated in a few places, particularly in the small ticket loans or instances of borrowers carrying debt across several lenders at once, and households taking new lines only to service old ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates its LAP business across 107 branches.
capex_expansion.quote: We now operate across 107 branches in 9 states and union territories.

margins_costs.claim: The company's average cost of borrowing fell from 14.45% to 13.76%.
margins_costs.quote: Even as borrowing costs rise across the system, our cost of borrowing has fallen by approximately 70 basis points, from 14.45% to 13.76%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects a 150 basis point reduction in incremental borrowing costs over the next 3 to 4 quarters.
margins_costs.quote: So, at the very least, there will be a 150 basis point reduction in the next 3 to 4 quarters.

margins_costs.claim: Credit cost of average AUM decreased to 6.80% from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Opex as a proportion of AUM decreased from 19.9% to 18.0%.
margins_costs.quote: You must have seen the operating leverage some evidence of that, 19.9% cost which was opex as a proportion of AUM has already come down to 18.0% percent.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of borrowing is expected to drop by a minimum of 100 basis points in the second half of FY27.
margins_costs.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

orders_capacity.claim: AUM reached Rs. 9,317 crore, up 68.4% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: AUM reached Rs. 9,317 crore, up 68.4% year-on-year, and 16.4% quarter on quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has served 12.8 million customers.
orders_capacity.quote: We have now served 12.8 million customers, up 22.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: Registered users grew by 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.
orders_capacity.quote: The registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Total disbursements for the quarter reached INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Disbursement for the quarter were INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The split between on-book AUM and off-book AUM stands at 46:54.
orders_capacity.quote: On-book AUM of INR 3,716 crores and off-book AUM of INR 4,284 crores, a 46:54 split, supported by more than 45 lending partners.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a preferential allotment of Rs. 832 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: We also completed a preferential allotment of Rs. 832 crore, approved by shareholders at the EGM on 14th October, and subsequently received in-principle approval from the exchanges.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that 75% of the preferential issue proceeds will be infused into the subsidiary to fund the balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% will go as infusion into our subsidiary to fund our balance sheet and increase our support, our growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹832.2 crore through a preferential issue of equity shares.
Capital adequacy in the NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% in the previous quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital adequacy in our NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, supported by retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, built on retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged rising gold loan exposure as a risk in September 2025.
risks_headwinds.quote: We flagged rising gold loan exposure as a risk in September 2025, and 13 months back began restricting lending to consumers carrying gold loan.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted that insurance is less than 1.4% of total income and expects no material impact from proposed IRDAI changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Insurance is less than 1.4% of our total income, our offerings have always been voluntary, and we expect no material impact on earnings.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical risks in West Asia pose potential second-order transmission effects through oil prices, shipping costs, and customer confidence.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first is West Asia, where the risk is not geography but transmission through higher oil prices, the cost of shipping, and, over time, the confidence of the customer.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects a cost of funding improvement of a minimum of 100 basis points over the next three quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Hey, just one adding, Krishnan has already mentioned so I don't want to reiterate it, but just the point which Krishnan said, over the next three quarter, we will see a cost of fund of minimum 100 basis point improvement if not higher.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
